# Spinwave Laundry

> Spinwave Laundry is a bright, modern, fully attended self-service laundromat coming soon to 112 S. Pacific Ave., San Pedro, CA 90731. Built around four promises: clean, fast, friendly, and safe.

## At a glance

- **Status**: Coming soon — public opening date not yet announced
- **Type**: Self-service laundromat, fully attended
- **Address**: 112 S. Pacific Ave., San Pedro, CA 90731
- **Phone**: (310) 480-3072
- **Email**: info@gospinwave.com
- **Instagram**: @spinwavelaundry
- **Website**: https://spinwavelaundry.com
- **Planned hours**: Monday–Sunday, 5:00 AM – 10:00 PM (open 7 days a week, 17 hours a day)
- **Service area**: San Pedro, CA and surrounding Los Angeles neighborhoods (ZIPs 90731, 90732, 90733)

## Equipment

Washers in five capacities — 20 lb (solo loads), 30 lb (couple loads), 40 lb (family loads), 60 lb (big loads), 80 lb (mega loads / oversized bedding). High-speed dryers in 30 lb (standard) and 55 lb (large) capacities.

## Amenities

- Fully attended (staff on site whenever we're open)
- Air conditioning
- Free fast WiFi
- Clean bathroom, maintained throughout the day
- Security cameras throughout the space
- Vending machine (detergent, drinks, snacks)
- Loyalty rewards program (earn free washes as a regular)
- Ample free parking right outside, well-lit
- New, high-efficiency machines
- Music

## Payment

Cash, credit card, debit card, Apple Pay.

## Brand voice and promise

Clean. Fast. Friendly. Safe. Bright, modern, and easy. The mascot is Splash, a friendly water drop character.

## Contact for press, partnerships, or questions

Email info@gospinwave.com or call (310) 480-3072.
